verdict.rationale: Claude Design is built around an in-product Claude assistant. Users describe a visual and Claude builds it, refine it through conversation, and collaborators can chat with Claude in group conversations. Hands-on community reports confirm that users delegated real design work, such as a landing page and animated SVGs, to the assistant. Missing for 10: documented depth of autonomous multi-step task delegation beyond the conversational build-and-refine loop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe a visual and Claude builds a first version, on brand.
you refine through conversation, inline comments, direct edits, or custom sliders (made by Claude) until it's right
grant edit access so colleagues can modify the design and chat with Claude together in a group conversation
